PLANNING COMMISSION 06/14/18
PLANNING COMMISSION 06/14/18
CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBER
38300 SIERRA HIGHWAY, SUITE B
PALMDALE, CALIFORNIA
Thursday JUNE 14, 2018
07:00 P.M.
www.cityofpalmdale.org
WELCOME
NOTICE: This meeting will be simulcast live on Time Warner Channel 27 and at www.cityofpalmdale.org.
PLEASE NOTE:
For record keeping purposes, if you wish to make a statement regarding any item on the agenda, please complete the Speaker Slip located on the side table and deposit it with the Deputy City Clerk. (Note: There is a three-minute time limit per speaker imposed. Please stay within this limit.)
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the Planning Division at 661/267 5200 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
If you wish to speak on an item, please fill out a Speaker's Slip and deliver it to the Deputy City Clerk BEFORE the item is discussed.
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments or cheering.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the Planning Commission to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off cell phones and electronic devices.
1. Call to Order
2. Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag
3. Roll Call: Chair Nemeth Vice Chair French
Commissioner Aleman, Avery, and Ward
4. Review of Agenda
5. Motion to Waive Full Reading of all Resolutions on the Agenda for this Meeting
6. Public Comments on Consent Calendar Items and any Items not on the Agenda
7. Consent Calendar Approval of Minutes from the Regular Planning Commission Meeting of May 10, 2018
Minutes
8. Public Hearings
8A. Approval of the Supplemental Environmental Impact Report for the Upper Amargosa Creek Recharge, Flood Control, and Riparian Habitat Restoration Project
City of Palmdale Public Works Department, Applicant
A request to use untreated aqueduct water to recharge the most depressed area of the underlying aquifer, the upper Amargosa Creek to the north of Elizabeth Lake Road between the California Aqueduct and 20th Street West, and also into the lower Amargosa Creek to the east of 10th Street West between Avenue M and Avenue O.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2018-017, approving the Supplemental Environmental Impact Report (SEIR) for the Upper Amargosa Creek Recharge, Flood Control, and Riparian Habitat Restoration Project (Amargosa Creek Project). Megan Taggart, Senior Planner
8A
8B. Conditional Use Permit 16-011 Major Modification
Guidance Charter School, Applicant
A request to modify the previously approved CUP 16-011 for a charter school located at the southwest corner of Avenue R and 40th Street East.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2018-020, approving a request to modify fencing and sports court facilities and find that the project will not result in any changes to the Mitigated Negative Declaration adopted for CUP 16-011 on September 8, 2016. Matthew Alcuran, Assistant Planner
8B
8C. Conditional Use Permit 14-023 Major Modification No. 2
Transplants Brewing, Applicant
A request to extend the hours of operation of the tasting room by opening 30 minutes earlier and closing two hours later as well as increasing the tasting area of the micro-brewery at 40242 La Quinta Lane.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission approve Conditional Use Permit (CUP) 14-023 Major Modification No. 2, a request to extend the hours of operation and increase the tasting area of Transplants Brewing, and find that the project is Categorically Exempt from environmental review. Justin Sauder, Assistant Planner
8C
8D. Zoning Ordinance Amendment 18-002
Mr. Giovanni Giammarco, Applicant
A request to amend the Palmdale Municipal Code (PMC) to allow small-scale furniture stores in the C-1 (Light Commercial) zone (PMC Section 17.51.050).
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2018-018 recommending that the City Council approve Zoning Ordinance Amendment 18-002 and find that the project is exempt from environmental review. Justin Sauder, Assistant Planner
8D
9. Staff Communications Development Updates
Rob Bruce, Planning Manager
10. Planning Commission Communications
11. Adjournment to the regular Planning Commission Meeting of Thursday, July 12, 2018, at 7:00 p.m., in the City of Palmdale Larry Chimbole Cultural Center
